{{Top|leg}}
'''Emergency space seals''' were used to patch emergency [[Hull/Legends|hull]] breaches. The seal was a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] in diameter and constructed of [[Bi-state memory plastic|bi-state plastic]]. The seal looked like a small cloth until unfurled via an [[activation stud]]. The seal would only last for about two [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], but that was usually long enough for a regular [[hull patch]] to be applied.
